eventPage.title: African Tourism University
eventPage.venue: Sofitel Hotel Ivoire, Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire
eventPage.intro: The 1st African Tourism University is a landmark event bringing together key actors in African tourism: public institutions, private operators, investors and international experts. This intensive day aims to lay the foundations for a sustainable, competitive and inclusive African tourism industry.
eventPage.rectorRole: Minister of Tourism and Leisure, Côte d'Ivoire
eventPage.rectorBio: Architect of the 'Sublime Côte d'Ivoire' strategy, Mr Fofana is a leading figure in West African tourism development. His patronage lends a major institutional dimension to this event.

about.title: The University for High-Performance Enterprises
about.subtitle: Building the capacity of executives, leaders and managers for lasting impact in Africa and beyond.
about.missionText1: ETHSUN Institute supports professionals, executives and leaders in upskilling through internationally recognised certification programmes. We believe that training is the most powerful lever for transforming organisations and African economies.
about.missionText2: Our programmes are designed by practitioner experts, grounded in African realities and enriched by the best international practices.
about.visionText: To become a leading academic institution with international reach, operating from our training hubs around the world. We aspire to create an educational ecosystem that connects Africa to global standards of professional excellence.
about.founderBio: Driven by the deep conviction that human capital is the primary lever of sustainable transformation, Jean-Calvin ETHIEN, CEO of ETHSUN Institute, is actively committed to skills development in Africa and internationally. Through a structured, demanding and impact-oriented approach, he works to design training programmes capable of strengthening individual capacities, supporting organisational performance and preparing a new generation of leaders equipped to meet contemporary economic, institutional and technological challenges.
about.founderAmbition: His ambition: to make ETHSUN Institute a leading international training group — a bridge between Oxford academic excellence, Swiss institutional rigour and African entrepreneurial dynamism.
